# Verification: spoilage timing and refrigeration (2026-09-24)

Decision: [0018](../decisions/0018-spoilage-timing-and-refrigeration.md). Final rule: refrigeration pauses spoilage (owner
decision). An earlier slowing model was withdrawn before commit; its evidence is not repeated here.

Compilation: live Editor `recompile`, no errors. Authoring: `run_script AgentScripts/BuildDevSite.cs` (`BuildDevSite.Run` →
"DevSite authored") after `DrawItemIcons.ps1` added `Fridge.png` (the other icons regenerated byte-identical). The run also
zeroed the FishNet `AssetPathHash` of `GoodsNetworkBridge.prefab` and `Player.prefab` and changed the blend of
`EquipmentGhost.mat`. These are unrelated to this feature, so the three files were restored from git and reimported.

The PlayMode failure is the known `HotbarKeysOverAStackAndDropsOnTheHotbarAssignSlots` hover test (see
[sell counter](sell-counter-20260924.md)). It was also confirmed in this session: with all changes stashed, it fails the
same way on the committed code.

Running-game observations: the fridge model stands between the counter and the oven (`world.png`). The fridge screen shows
"Refrigerated 1/8" and "Goods in here do not spoil." (`fridge-screen.png`). Both dough stacks' slot timers read `1h`: the
inventory one in white, the fridge one frozen in blue. The hover lines read `Dough ×2 · spoils in 1h 59m` and
`Dough ×3 · refrigerated: not spoiling (1h 59m left out of the cold)`. The hover line stays within the grid's width, so
the centred screen does not move under the pointer. The readout shows the storage hint.

New or changed coverage:

- `RefrigerationTests` (Goods, 2, new): a placed fridge's refrigerated input pauses spoilage (30 s exposure unchanged after
  1000 s) and stays refrigerated through pickup and placement; out of the cold, spoilage resumes; `Validate` rejects an
  unrefrigerated fridge input. A job's overshoot into a refrigerated output adds no exposure, in one step or 25 one-second
  steps.
- The existing `GoodsWorldTests.RefrigerationStopsFutureExposureButMovingNeverResetsHistory` and
  `DurableClockAndExposureRecoverWithoutClientOrPresentation` already cover pausing in a refrigerated location across reloads.
- `SessionAuthoringTests` (Session, +10 cases, 1 changed): fridge definition, prefab, icon, recipe-free kind and supplier
  offer; `PlayerHud.FormatDuration` cases; `DevSite` lists three equipment definitions and four offers.

Not verified: a player build; a two-process session; a real mouse hover (the capture set the HUD's hover state directly,
because the only automated hover path is the failing test above).
